paite: Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat bel lungmuangtak in Jerusalem a a-inn ah apai nawnta hi.
heading: Zawlnei Khat In Jehoshaphat Atai
english: Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in zawlnei Hanani tapa Jehu in ana dawn a, kumpipa Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Migilou na panpih in ToUPA ho mite na it ding ahi maw? Hiai ziak in TOUPA thangpaihna, na tung ah ahong omta hi.
english: Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to King Jehoshaphat, “Should you help the wicked, and love those who hate Yahweh? Because of this, wrath is on you from before Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh hiai gam a kipan Asherah na paimang a, TOUPA na zon ziak in hoihna lam banghiam khat na nei lai hi," achi hi.
english: Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have put away the Asheroth out of the land, and have set your heart to seek God.”

paite: Jehoshaphat bel Jerusalem ah a-om a; huan Beer-sheba a kipan a Ephraim tanggam pha in amite lak ah ahoh nawn a, TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian lam ah ama'n apikik nawn vek hi.
heading: Jehoshaphat Puahthakna Bawlte
english: Jehoshaphat lived at Jerusalem; and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim, and brought them back to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

paite: Huchi in kho chih ah Judah gam kulh nei khopi tengteng ah vaihawmte akoih a, vaihawmte kiang ah,
english: He set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city,

paite: "Na thilhih uh hoihtak a ngaihtuah in hih un, mihing a ding a vaihawm na hi kei ua, TOUPA a ding ahi zaw ngal a; vaihawmna ah na kiang uah atel zel ahi.
english: and said to the judges, “Consider what you do, for you don’t judge for man, but for Yahweh; and he is with you in the judgment.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA lau unla, pilvangtak in hih un; TOUPA i Pathian ah gitlouhna, khentuam neihna leh golh neknate a-om kei," achi hi.
english: Now therefore let the fear of Yahweh be on you. Take heed and do it; for there is no iniquity with Yahweh our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of bribes.”

paite: Huchi in Jehoshaphat in Jerusalem a ahong kik nawn un TOUPA vaihawm ding leh thubuaite lemmi ding in Levite, siampute, Israel inkuan makaite akoih behlap hi.
english: Moreover in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed certain Levites, priests, and heads of the fathers’ households of Israel to give judgment for Yahweh and for controversies. They returned to Jerusalem.

paite: "TOUPA laudan siam kawm in muanhuaitak in, lungsim diktak pu in na hih ding uh ahi.
english: He commanded them, saying, “You shall do this in the fear of Yahweh, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.

paite: Koi lai khua a mi in leng thubuai ahong gen ua, tualthah thu, dan leh thupiak thu, dan thuseh leh vaihawm thute a hong kilan uleh, TOUPA tung a thil ahihkhelhlouhna ding un amau pilvangtak in na hilh ding ua, nou leh na unaute uh tung ah thangpaihna ahong tung zenhouh kha ding; huchibang in hih le uchin, mohsak in na om kei ding uhi.
english: Whenever any controversy comes to you from your brothers who dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and ordinances, you must warn them, that they not be guilty toward Yahweh, and so wrath come on you and on your brothers. Do this, and you will not be guilty.

paite: "Huan ngai dih ua, TOUPA lam thu tengteng ah siampu lianpen Amariah bel na heutu uh ahi a; kumpipa lam thu tengteng ah Judah inkote tung a vaihawmmi Ishmael tapa Zebadiah ahi: Levite leng na heutute uh ahi sam ding uh. Hangtak in hih unla, mihoihte kiang ah TOUPA om hen," achi hi.
english: Behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of Yahweh; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in all the king’s matters. Also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and may Yahweh be with the good.”
